priority_items.title: SPC PacNet 15 Sep: Majuro dengue and PNG measles red alerts; Yap diarrhoea grey alert
priority_items.summary: Catch-up. SPC/PPHSN weekly epidemic-alert map dated 15 Sep records dengue DENV-1 red alert in Majuro (66 confirmed to 5 Sep, during WIM ExCom 25), measles red alert in PNG including Bougainville (8 lab-confirmed YTD), and a grey alert for watery diarrhoea in Yap, FSM (169 clinical cases to 13 Sep, no deaths). Not FLASH. Exact intra-day timestamp not stated on ReliefWeb.

priority_items.title: PNG Independence Day underway; still no BPS SITREP or Lloyds reply to RNZ
priority_items.summary: 16 Sep local Independence Day began 14:00 UTC. No new Marape/Toroama Panguna language located this hour. RNZ 15 Sep piece still says it has reached out to Lloyds. Post Courier LPMEL headline unchanged and paywalled. Fatalities remain PNG-media CLAIM.

priority_items.title: PMMM-4 sitting from 19:30 UTC; MV Matui toll band unchanged
priority_items.summary: Tonga is 03:55 local 16 Sep at cutoff. Official programme lists sitting 08:30–17:10 TOT; Matatoa/ministerial declaration adoption 15:30–17:00 TOT (02:30–04:00 UTC 16 Sep). No adopted text. Matui still 2 dead / 14 survivors / ~30+ missing. VFSC strike-off remains Daily Post CLAIM.
